page.overview:
Who is Adolphus Krieger?

Adolphus Krieger was a mighty Vampire Lord and Blood Knight, counted among both the von Carstein and Lahmian bloodlines.

Across the centuries, Krieger had seen more of the Known World than any mortal could hope to witness in a single lifetime. He had stood beneath the midnight shadow of the Black Pyramid of Nagash in the Land of the Dead, and heard the whispers of ancient kings stirring within the necropolises of Nehekhara. He had wandered to the very edges of the Realms of Chaos, whose horrors seemed to hold no fear for him, and travelled through Bretonnia, Estalia, Tilea and nearly every known realm of Men.

Over the ages, he conversed not only with kings, queens, and lesser rulers, but also with renowned painters, poets, and philosophers. He debated philosophy with Neumann, and discussed poetry and playwriting with von Diehl, Detlef Sierck, and Jacopo Tarradasch.

For more than a thousand years, since the Age of Three Emperors, the Vampire Adolphus Krieger has existed in the Old World. He has witnessed the rise and fall of the von Carstein bloodline, but is quite certain that he will succeed where his predecessors failed. To do this, he only needs to possess an artefact of great power, created by the Great Necromancer himself.
